notes.title: Update notes for September 14th, 2024
notes.notes:
Just a few bug fixes for Windows and Linux:

- Fixed a bug where the Achievements screen wasn't pulling achievement status from Steam.
- Fixed order of main menu buttons so that the Achievement button is in the menu / tab order.

Ran into issues with the macOS version of these changes.  I may end up removing the macOS version as it becomes more difficult to update.

notes.title: Achievements added!
notes.notes:
Steam Achievements have been added to the game!

We've added thirty-seven (37) achievements including some very challenging achievements like completing all 1,000 challenge levels with 3 stars!

When you launch the game after this update you will see a screen like the one below letting you know achievements have been added.  The game will check for any achievements you may have already earned.  Not all achievements can be checked for prior completion because the data needed to earn them wasn't being tracked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41317587/2543d043239cd6f16af875c1c8dffd225531afd8.png[/img]

Let us know if you run into any issues with this update!

notes.title: Update notes for December 17th, 2022
notes.notes:
- The number of cards left now appears under the deck
- Challenge mode levels show the number of stars earned instead of score
- A number of improvements for keyboard users, including using the arrow keys to move between level select screens, using 1 to select the first level and then using arrow keys to move between levels.
